newsitem.title: POLAND: Ousted Polish leader honoured 10 years late.
newsitem.headline: Ousted Polish leader honoured 10 years late.

text.p: Ten years late, Poland has honoured former communist leader Edward Gierek and his wife Stanislawa with a state medal awarded to couples who reach 50 years of marriage, PAP news agency said on Tuesday.
The report said the then-communist authorities "forgot" the Giereks when they reached their 50th anniversary in 1987.
The award of the medal now was decided by President Aleksander Kwasniewski, himself a former communist.
Gierek, whose borrowing during 10 years in power burdened Poland with a huge foreign debt, was ousted as communist leader at the start of the Solidarity free trade union revolt in 1980.
He and his wife have since lived in quiet retirement at Ustronie near Katowice in southern Poland.
